items.prompt: The input is a 3 by 1 token grid with rows [x], [y], [z]. What should spiral(3,1,grid) return?

options.why: The top row is only the first cell. The right-edge step must still visit y and z.
After the only column is consumed, the later left-column step must not repeat y.
A one-column rectangle is legal. Updated bounds emit each row once in top-to-bottom order.
The declared public dimensions are independent and rectangular grids are allowed.
